help.help_title: How can we help you today?
help.help_description: Browse the platform's comprehensive user guide and learn how to manage your account and lessons easily according to your role.
help.help_search_placeholder: Search for a topic, question, or guide...
help.download_manual_desc: You can download the user manual as a standalone document file to open on your device or print as PDF/Word.
help.rules_subtitle: General rules governing platform finances and scheduling.
help.rule_cancel_desc: Booking cancellation is available for free up to 24 hours before the lesson starts. Cancelling after that deducts the full amount to compensate the teacher.
help.rule_trial_desc: The platform grants one free 30-minute trial session per parent to experience the quality of teaching without any commitments.
help.rule_commission_desc: The system deducts a default operating commission of 15% from the private lesson value to ensure service maintenance and continuity.
help.rule_schedule_desc: Appointments cannot be booked with any teacher less than 2 hours before the actual start time to ensure both parties are prepared.
help.jitsi_title: Video Room System & Virtual Classroom Security
help.jitsi_desc: The system relies on Jitsi Meet to launch lessons. Room links are generated randomly and securely. The link opens automatically 5 minutes before the scheduled session and closes immediately when the total lesson time ends.
help.guide_parent_desc: Step-by-step instructions to book lessons for your children.
help.parent_step1_desc: Go to the 'Students' section in your dashboard and add your children's names and grades (from grade 1 to 12).
help.parent_step2_desc: Browse teachers' profiles and choose an available green slot that fits your child's schedule.
help.parent_step3_desc: After submitting the request, transfer the fees and upload the receipt image for the admin to verify and confirm your booking.
help.parent_step4_desc: Enter the room on time. After the session ends, you can read the teacher's report on your child's level and write your review.
help.guide_teacher_desc: How to manage your lessons and earnings in the system.
help.teacher_step1_desc: Enter your recurring work days and hours. No one will be able to book you outside this schedule.
help.teacher_step2_desc: Incoming booking requests from parents must be reviewed and accepted/rejected so they can pay.
help.teacher_step3_desc: After completing the session, write a report (topic & homework). Without this report, the session won't be included in your earnings.
help.guide_admin_desc: How to verify data and manage the system.
help.admin_step1_desc: Review payment receipts uploaded by parents and confirm bookings to activate the video link.
help.admin_step2_desc: Review teachers' certificates and classify their levels (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to bring credibility to the platform.
help.admin_step3_desc: Automatic payouts engine to prevent double payout (a session enters exactly one payouts run and cannot be duplicated).
help.faq_desc: Search and browse common answers to resolve issues.
help.faq_q1: What are the conditions for cancelling classes and refunding fees?
help.faq_a1: Parents can cancel the session and automatically get a refund up to 24 hours before the session. If cancelled after that, the full fee is charged and goes to the teacher as slot compensation.
help.faq_q2: How can I add a new child to my account?
help.faq_a2: Go to Parent Dashboard ➡️ Students ➡️ click 'Add New Student' and fill in their name, grade, and school. This helps us customize lessons and curriculum.
help.faq_q3: How do I pay after booking a session?
help.faq_a3: After booking a session, go to 'My Sessions', you will see the status 'Awaiting Payment'. Click the payment button and upload the bank transfer receipt to activate it.
help.faq_q4: How do I set my work hours in the schedule?
help.faq_a4: Go to Teacher Dashboard ➡️ Availability. Select your preferred recurring weekly work days and hours, then save. Parents can only book you during these hours.
help.faq_q5: Why must I submit a session report after the session?
help.faq_a5: Submitting a session report (topics covered, student feedback, homework) is a prerequisite for completing the session in the payouts system and releasing your earnings.
help.faq_q6: How are teacher payouts settled and double payments prevented?
help.faq_a6: The system provides a Payouts Engine that links every completed booking to a unique, independent payout ID. Once a session is paid in a payout run, it is closed and cannot be added to any other payout run.

home.announcement_text: Special back-to-school offer! Get 20% off your first session.
home.hero_badge_message: A new and more enjoyable way to learn ✨
home.hero_subheadline: And here at EduNest, we made the search for this guide easier and more enjoyable. Join us and discover the joy of personalized learning.
home.hero_primary_btn_text: Start your learning journey with us
home.persuasion_title: Why do parents trust us and students love us?
home.persuasion_subtitle: Let's listen to what Hakeem and Najeeb have to say...
home.persuasion_hakeem_quote: "My son, time is our most precious asset. Personalized tutoring shortens distances, focuses on weaknesses, and builds self-confidence much faster than traditional methods."
home.persuasion_najeeb_quote: "Absolutely right! The best part is that I can choose the teacher who understands me, at a time that suits me perfectly without changing my busy daily schedule."
home.journey_title: Our learning journey is simple and clear
home.journey_subtitle: Four steps separate you from a premium learning experience
home.journey_step1_desc: Browse certified teachers' profiles and learn about their specialties and style.
home.journey_step2_desc: Choose a convenient time from the teacher's availability and pay securely.
home.journey_step3_desc: Join the live interactive session and start your personalized learning.
home.journey_step4_desc: Monitor your progress, get periodic reports, and ensure your academic success.
home.assurance_title: We guarantee a safe and reliable learning experience
home.assurance_subtitle: Everything you need to focus on learning only
home.assurance_feature1_desc: We review and verify all teachers' certificates and IDs to ensure a safe, high-quality environment.
home.assurance_feature2_desc: Live interactive sessions supported by tools like a whiteboard and screen sharing.
home.assurance_feature3_desc: Protected payment system with a money-back guarantee in case of dissatisfaction.
home.assurance_feature4_desc: Our team is always available to answer your questions and solve any issue.
home.footer_cta_subtitle: Join hundreds of students who achieved their academic goals with EduNest's outstanding teachers.
